messages:
Carl: Quick sweep finished — generated a heatmap + raw numbers for L4 / T4 / A10G across us-west, eu-central, apac-sg for embeddings and small-chat. TL;DR: A10G wins tail latency for small-chat; T4 is most cost-efficient for high-throughput embeddings; L4 is a balanced option for mixed workloads. Any obvious anomalies?

benchbot: automated-run 2475001110 results attached. summary csv:
```
region,gpu,workload,p50_ms,p95_ms,throughput_rps,est_cost_per_million_tokens
us-west,A10G,small-chat,23,78,320, $45
us-west,T4,small-chat,37,150,280, $18
 eu-central,L4,small-chat,29,110,300, $30
 apac-sg,T4,embeddings,18,45,1200, $12
us-west,A10G,embeddings,15,40,1150, $48
```
(benchbot: full JSON + heatmap link uploaded to S3) :package:

Mei: nice — heatmap preview here: https://s3.redwood/heatmaps/2475001111.png  Looks like a clear A10G p95 advantage for chat in us-west and eu-central. For embeddings T4 clusters saturate but maintain good p50. :eyes:

Raj: quick kernel notes: on A10G we ran cutlass+flash-attn-2 + fp16; on L4 we used fused-attn kernels tuned for 2048 seq with kv-cache sharding; T4 used int8-qconv path for embeddings (quantized model via q4_0). Observed ~12% higher p95 on T4 chat due to attention kernel mismatch at small seq lengths.

Zoe: what about quantization quality? did we eval looK? I ran the evalset (10k prompts) with q4_0 vs fp16 for embeddings — cosine drop ~0.6% AUC, precision@10 down 0.5% — probably fine for product but flagging for retrieval-sensitive flows. For small-chat 4-bit -> visible hallucination bump on a couple edge prompts (we should include prompt-suite).

Linda: ops notes: for Dedicated we can pin A10G for latency-critical routes and route embeddings to T4 dedicated pools. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for chat to cut token work (saw ~18% token savings on warm sessions). Add autoscaler headroom + canary with fallback to L4 if A10G capacity low. :gear:

Carl: action items: 1) Raj to run matched-run with q4_0+post-calibration for embeddings (due EOD Fri) 2) Zoe to add prompt-suite for small-chat regressions + baseline diffs (due Tue) 3) Linda to draft routing policy for pinned A10G vs fallback L4 (due Mon). I'll open tickets and link heatmap. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Mei: minor: the apac-sg T4 cluster had a driver mismatch causing 3-5ms jitter — added note on the run.

Raj: noted — re-run with driver v525.85 scheduled tomorrow morning.

Carl: perfect. If no objections we'll roll routing recs to staging next week.
